hero.subtitle: Earnings and demand computed from real structured salary offers on the marketplace — with period and sample size, never estimated figures.

definition.title: What does an electrician do?
definition.text: An electrician installs, maintains and repairs electrical installations — from homes and offices to industrial systems and charging stations. NEN 1010/3140 apply, and safety certifications such as VCA are standard requirements.
